storage: Must be processed immediately after harvest (within 48 hours). Delay causes sucrose loss.
apmc_guideline: FRP (Fair and Remunerative Price) of Rs.340/quintal mandated by central government for 2026-27. All sugar mills must pay FRP within 14 days of delivery.

storage: Dry godown or silo. Moisture must be below 10% before storage to prevent fungal growth.
apmc_guideline: MSP of Rs.5328/quintal applicable (2026-27). Moisture and foreign matter content checked before procurement by NAFED or government agencies.

storage: Dry godown. Moisture must be below 8.5% to maintain fiber quality.
apmc_guideline: MSP set by CCI (Cotton Corporation of India) at Rs.6620/quintal for Long Staple (2026-27). Staple length and trash content determine final grade and price premium.

storage: Dry godown or metal bins. Moisture below 12%. Protected from rodents and insects.
apmc_guideline: MSP of Rs.3699/quintal (2026-27). Grain must be clean, dry, and free of weevils. APMC markets conduct mandatory weighing and grading before auction.

storage: Dry, well-ventilated farm shed or APMC shed. Moisture content must be below 10% to prevent sprouting and fungal rot.
apmc_guideline: No MSP for onion. APMC auction is mandatory in Maharashtra. Grading (size: >55mm=Grade A, 40-55mm=Grade B) required. Export quality requires APEDA certification.

storage: Dry godown or hermetic metal bins. Moisture below 12%. Susceptible to Aspergillus mold if wet.
apmc_guideline: MSP of Rs.2775/quintal (2026-27). Grain must pass moisture test at APMC weighbridge. Mixing of grades is prohibited.

storage: Dry godown or silo for paddy (Moisture < 14%), milled rice (<12%). FCI godown standards applicable for PDS procurement.
apmc_guideline: MSP for Paddy (Common) is Rs.2369/quintal (2026-27). FCI and state agencies procure at MSP during procurement season (Nov-Jan). Broken grain percentage determines grade.
